Compute the associated matrix of a simplicial cone

Source: R/utils.R
compute_associated_matrix.Rd

Constructs the associated matrix M_n(C) for a simplicial cone C generated by unit vectors v1, ..., vn. The matrix has 1's on the diagonal and \(-|v_i \cdot v_j|\) for off-diagonal entries (Definition 1.4).

Usage

compute_associated_matrix(V)

Arguments

V

An n x n matrix where columns are the unit vectors generating the cone

Value

An n x n symmetric matrix

Details

The associated matrix is used to determine convergence of the hypergeometric series formula (Theorem 1.5). The series converges if and only if this matrix is positive definite.

References

Fitisone, A., & Zhou, Y. (2023). Solid angle measure of polyhedral cones. arXiv:2304.11102 (math.CO). https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.11102

Ribando, J. M. (2006). Measuring solid angles beyond dimension three. Discrete & Computational Geometry, 36(3), 479-487. doi:10.1007/s00454-006-1253-4

Examples

# 2D example
v1 <- c(1, 0) / sqrt(1)
v2 <- c(1, 1) / sqrt(2)
V <- cbind(v1, v2)
M <- compute_associated_matrix(V)
print(M)
#>            [,1]       [,2]
#> [1,]  1.0000000 -0.7071068
#> [2,] -0.7071068  1.0000000

# Check positive definiteness
eigen(M)$values  # All positive
#> [1] 1.7071068 0.2928932
